notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least four counters on it.
description:
Activate Inga and Esika by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte three times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping three lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {2}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.
